semantic_roles.meaning: The base reading plane on which every other role sits.
A plane set apart from the base to group a related task without implying depth or status.
Body copy, figures and labels that carry the main meaning.
Supporting copy such as sources, dates and explanations.
The visible edge of any control a person can act on.
The location of keyboard or switch focus, always visible.
The one figure or statement a view exists to answer.
Debt paid down and time remaining, shown as fact rather than reward.
Ranges, low-confidence readings and projections, always stated with their basis.
Where a figure came from, who changed it and when.
Conditions needing attention, stated without blame or alarm.
Actions that change the person's plan, sharing or data, including how to reverse them.

platform_consequences.android: Whichever direction is selected is expressed through Material components and semantic roles only; no Android-specific identity, palette or type system may be introduced, and the selected direction's feasibility notes for Android apply.
platform_consequences.web: The customer web app adopts the same semantic roles and thesis as Android; responsive layouts may reflow but may not invent a separate web identity.
platform_consequences.admin: The admin console uses a neutral, metadata-first variant of the same direction; operator access to user financial detail is always shown as an audited, time-boxed elevation, never as ordinary browsing.

unresolved_risks: No representative-user concept evidence exists yet; preference, comprehension and identification for every candidate are unknown (docs#53).
Persona-dependent assumptions in every candidate are unvalidated (docs#66).
Illustrative contrast values fail for some candidates; the selected direction's final values must be set and verified by the token contract (docs#55).
Accessibility, Content and Android, web and admin feasibility reviews have not been recorded.
Cultural fit of the signage and textile traditions needs review by designers from those traditions.
implementation_consequences: Component and screen work waits for an approved direction; no platform team may start a separate visual system.
The token contract is authored in docs#55 after approval and consumes only the semantic roles named here.
The governed library (docs#78) references the approved record version, never a pending one.
Reversal requires a superseding D2 record and a design-system migration plan.

supersession.requires: A superseding D2 record signed by the decision coordinator and a design-system migration plan.
